CLOUD FIXER seat for tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, topic r10-ratio-anchor, at head 50af6174f53c0f9bec3f705c3a4bb99615f71acc. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch 50af6174f53c0f9bec3f705c3a4bb99615f71acc for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-ratio-anchor, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-ratio-anchor <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-ratio-anchor; that second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
D-3 (D12-s2-71, medium, verified): the lower-floor learned ratio has no re-anchor, so a nameplate edit or a snapshot restore misattributes the change, upper -36.8 % and lower +21.5 % after an options reseed. The owner's install is two-zone, so this bites directly. Re-anchor the stored ratio (the thermal-learning domain in custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/store.py) when the prior it multiplies moves. G-ID-3 from the identifiability study is the same mechanism on a meter add: re-anchor the learner scales when a power meter is added. The heat-meter add is wired to this mechanism by R10-HEAT-METER, which runs later.

Forward-carried (finding-propagation.md): (1) The adopt-learned-values options step (G4) is offered only after this group lands, and is not a card button. (2) Lead for the sysid stage (fails safe, not owed): at scale 1.3 with ratio at least 1.2 the production experiment aborts as drifted beyond its excursion. (3) Null control: ratio 1.0 reads 0.0000 on both zones.

ARCHITECT NOTE (orchestrator.md section 5, binding under fixer.md step 17). Hot files and their serial chain: config_flow.py (position 1 of 3; before you: none; next: R10-HEAT-METER, R10-CONFIGFLOW-PAGES); coordinator.py (seam-ordered; before you: none; after you: R10-HEAT-METER, R10-PARAMS-OWNER). Owning seam in this group: the options-save path and the stored ratio. Shape: re-anchor at the write of the prior; no new coordinator state. Touch only the owning seam named here; a hunk outside it is a new conflict surface and needs the orchestrator's after-edge first. Start from main. Re-run fixer.md steps 2-8 after any rebase.

Identity and flow: the seat pushes refs only, through tools/audit/seat/handoff_push.sh and tools/audit/seat/bus.sh; every GitHub write is the orchestrator's (decisions 0011 and 0013). Work from fresh origin/main in your own worktree under your ABSOLUTE scratch directory; stop only PIDs you started. Follow dev/governance/roles/fixer.md: failing test first, mutation proof, the finder's harness at both ends, a null control for every quantified claim, `GATE_SCOPE` auto, tests/structure.py before push. Every figure above is a snapshot at the finding's baseline: re-derive it at your merge base. Owner gate: none (the approver App approves). Models: fixer opus, reviewer opus. Closing: the pull request names every issue in this group's `issues` in prose with a closing keyword only for those in `fixes`, and Part of for the rest; the orchestrator verifies each intended issue closed after the merge.
